title: Why Are Airplane Windows Round? ✈️ #shorts
description:
Square windows once tore jets apart. Here's how cabin pressure flows through a plane's skin, why sharp corners turn into crack starters, what happened to the de Havilland Comet in 1954, and what that tiny hole in your window actually does.

Follow Hidden Mechanics for more everyday engineering, explained in under a minute.
